module_summary: AXI-Lite read width adapter: a two-state IDLE/DATA FSM forwards AR requests to the master side and returns R data, splitting into segments when the master is narrower.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/DATA controller sequencing address forwarding and read-data return.

anchors.name: s_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: Slave read-address valid; accepted in IDLE to start a transfer.

anchors.name: s_axil_arready
anchors.why: Slave read-address ready, registered, gates request acceptance.

anchors.name: s_axil_araddr
anchors.why: Slave read address, latched into master address register.

anchors.name: s_axil_rdata
anchors.why: Read data returned to slave side from s_axil_rdata_reg.

anchors.name: s_axil_rvalid
anchors.why: Slave read-data valid, set when response is complete.

anchors.name: s_axil_rready
anchors.why: Slave read-data ready; clears rvalid.

anchors.name: m_axil_araddr
anchors.why: Master read address driven from m_axil_araddr_reg.

anchors.name: m_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: Master read-address valid issued per segment.

anchors.name: m_axil_arready
anchors.why: Master read-address ready; clears arvalid.

anchors.name: m_axil_rdata
anchors.why: Master read data shifted or packed into slave rdata register.

anchors.name: m_axil_rvalid
anchors.why: Master read-data valid; with rready completes a beat.

anchors.name: m_axil_rready
anchors.why: Master read-data ready, asserted in DATA when slave rvalid clear.

anchors.name: s_axil_rdata_reg
anchors.why: Accumulates read data segments across beats before returning to slave.

anchors.name: m_axil_araddr_reg
anchors.why: Holds master address, increments per segment, selects shift offset.

anchors.name: current_segment_reg
anchors.why: Segment counter for narrow master; indexes rdata packing and ends transfer.

anchors.name: s_axil_rresp_reg
anchors.why: Holds accumulated read response returned on s_axil_rresp.

anchors.name: s_axil_rresp
anchors.why: Read response to slave side.

anchors.name: m_axil_rresp
anchors.why: Master read response, propagated into slave rresp.

anchors.name: s_axil_arprot
anchors.why: Protection bits forwarded to master arprot.

anchors.name: m_axil_arprot
anchors.why: Forwarded protection bits on master side.

groups.name: read_fsm
groups.description: IDLE/DATA state machine and segment counter sequencing transfers.

groups.name: slave_ar_channel
groups.description: Accepts read-address requests from the AXI-Lite slave port.

groups.name: master_ar_channel
groups.description: Issues read addresses per segment on the AXI-Lite master port.

groups.name: read_data_path
groups.description: Shifts or packs master read data and response into slave R channel.
